messages:
olivia: Noticed a drift: three prod snapshot objects missing SSE headers in the last audit window. Query: ./scripts/find_snapshots --since 2025-06-05 --missing-sse

encops-bot: ALERT: 3 PUTs without ServerSideEncryption metadata in bucket snapshots-prod. times=2025-06-05T02:14:07Z,2025-06-05T02:15:33Z,2025-06-05T02:16:01Z user=svc-backup-uploader

olivia: Owner: svc-backup-uploader. Looks like this coincides with an IAM trimming PR that removed kms:Encrypt on uploader role (PR:git/infra#5582).

raj: @jasper any chance the uploader agent changed mode from SSE-S3 to SSE-KMS recently? We added CMEK on that bucket last month.

jasper: Yes, bucket policy was switched to enforce SSE-KMS (tag:env=prod,managed=snapshots) on 2025-05-12. The uploader was supposed to get a scoped kms:Encrypt grant for the CMK. The change to its role was merged earlier today.

olivia: So double failure: uploader lacks kms:Encrypt -> uploaded objects accepted but missing SSE metadata, which our restore service assumes present. That will break restore validation and compliance.

lina: Quick mitigation: add a head-object check on restore path to surface a clear error instead of returning a 500. Also put a temporary deny to restore API until we validate objects. I'll open a patch.

encops-bot: scheduled scan: ./scripts/scan_unencrypted_snapshots.sh --bucket snapshots-prod --since 2025-06-01 -> result: 3 objects

jasper: For remediation we have two viable approaches: 1) server-side copy with correct SSE-KMS header using role with kms:Encrypt/kms:ReEncrypt* and s3:PutObjectAcl. 2) re-run uploader pipeline to re-upload from source if available. The server-side copy will re-encrypt but requires the CMK grant.

raj: Jasper, can your key admin re-grant kms:Encrypt to svc-backup-uploader with a strict condition (arn matches snapshots-prod path and source account)? If yes, that plus a server-side copy script can fix objects without restoring from pipeline.

jasper: I can add a short-lived grant (15m) scoped to the CMK and bucket prefix. Will push an emergency ACL with condition kms:ViaService = s3.amazonaws.com and resourceLimit.

olivia: Action list: jasper -> create short-lived CMK grant + post audit log (ETA 10m); lina -> add restore preflight fail and add unit test (ETA 45m); raj -> add detection alert (Datadog) for s3 PUTs missing x-amz-server-side-encryption (ETA 30m); olivia -> run copy script once grant is active and verify checksums (ETA 1h).

jasper: Also adding KMS policy rule to alert on policy changes that revoke Encrypt for keys tagged managed=snapshots. That would've caught this PR.

lina: Small code snippet for head-object guard:
```
meta=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket snapshots-prod --key "$key")
if [ -z "$(echo $meta | jq -r '.ServerSideEncryption')" ]; then
  echo "missing SSE: aborting restore for $key"; return 422
fi
```

raj: We should also add a CI lint: any PR that changes iam/* roles touching svc-backup-uploader must include a compliance checkbox when the bucket uses CMEK. Prevent accidental permission pruning.

olivia: Note for postmortem: include timeline, reviewer who approved PR 5582, and why the CMK dependency wasn't in the role change description.

encops-bot: copy_job started by olivia using elevated-role; source=prod-uploader-cache/2025-06-05/; dest=s3://snapshots-prod/2025-06-05/abc123 copy_result=success checksum_match=true

lina: Copy succeeded for 2/3 objects; one object missing local source artifact. Marked for customer comms review.

raj: I'll schedule a 1-hour post-incident meeting after remediation. Also opening a Jira ENCOPS-762 to track follow-ups (enforce CI gate, KMS policy alert, playbook updates).

olivia: Thanks all. Keep all confirmations in this thread. If restores fail, escalate to #incidents.
